land_pattern.package: SC-70-6 (datasheet section 9.1 'SC70-6 Package Outline Dimensions'; 6-lead 3+3 gull-wing, same land family as SOT-363)
land_pattern.notes: NOT A RECOMMENDED LAND PATTERN - section 9.1 is titled 'Package Outline Dimensions' and this datasheet publishes no solder-land drawing at all. pitch_mm = e = 0.65 TYP (lead pitch) from the 9.1 table. pad_size_mm and row_spacing_mm DELIBERATELY OMITTED: the PDF gives lead metal width (b) and the across-leads envelope (E) but no land sizes and no land row spacing. PACKAGE OUTLINE TABLE 9.1 (mm, min/max): A 0.90/1.10; A1 0.00/0.10; A2 0.90/1.00; b (lead width) 0.15/0.35; c (lead thickness) 0.08/0.15; D (body length) 2.05/2.25; E (overall width across formed leads) 2.15/2.45; E1 (body width) 1.15/1.35; e 0.65 TYP; e1 (pin1-to-pin3 span, = 2 x e) 1.2/1.4; L (foot length) 0.26/0.46; L1 0.525 REF; lead foot flat 0.20; lead angle theta 0 to 8 degrees. PIN-1 LOCATION: the p.2 SC70-6 pinning diagram places pins 1-2-3 down one side (1 at the top) and 6-5-4 down the other (6 at the top), i.e. pin 1 faces pin 6, pin 2 faces pin 5, pin 3 faces pin 4 - the same opposition the p.2 SOT23-6 view draws physically (bottom row 1-2-3 = B1/GND/B0, top row 6-5-4 = Select/Vcc/A). The 9.1 outline drawing shows the 3+3 lead arrangement but does NOT number the leads and shows no pin-1 index/dot, so the physical pin-1 corner marking is not stated by this PDF.
